=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text minus "-"
global row ulong 16
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note each row comes from the one above in place, right to left: row[j] += row[j-1]; each row is
note indented so the triangle is centred, two columns per level
fn pascal n ulong to void
put row 0 1
for r ulong n
for x ulong mul 2 sub sub n r 1
emit sp
end
for j ulong add r 1
if gt j 0
emit sp
end
emitu get row j
end
emit nl
put row add r 1 1
for x ulong r
j = sub r x
put row j add get row j get row sub j 1
end
end
end
fn main to int
pascal 10
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
